summary: The diff implements most of the required functionality: a stable backend map with admin-only get/set functions (REQ-1), a useTSICLabels hook with mutation (REQ-3), and a LoggerIdLabelEditor component on the TSIC Loggers page gated by admin status (REQ-2). However, the TSICLoggersPage.tsx is truncated and does not clearly show the admin gate wrapping the LoggerIdLabelEditor, so we cannot fully confirm non-admin DOM exclusion. The backend is also truncated, preventing full verification of getAllLoggerLabels and setLoggerIdLabel implementations. Based on available evidence, implementation appears largely complete with some unverifiable portions due to truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: For non-admin users, neither the text field nor any label text appears in the rendered DOM. The component must not render the label data into the DOM at all for non-admins.
missing_requirements.reason: The TSICLoggersPage.tsx diff is truncated and does not show the section where LoggerIdLabelEditor is conditionally rendered based on isAdmin. The LoggerIdLabelEditor component itself contains no admin check — it relies entirely on the parent to gate rendering. We cannot confirm from the available diff that the editor is strictly gated behind an isAdmin check in the page component.

hallucinated_features.description: A separate backend/migration.mo module was added to handle canister upgrade state migration using a structured migration pattern.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only requires stable storage surviving upgrades and that all Motoko logic remain in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture). Creating a separate migration.mo file was not requested and introduces an architectural element beyond what was specified.
